Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator introduced a flawed greedy algorithm and fabricated the road layout instead of using the actual file content. After placing a tower at house[i] + 4 (the tower center), the code only advanced houses ≤ tower_position rather than ≤ tower_position + 4, ignoring the tower’s right-side 4-mile coverage. This logic error (carried forward into the revised script) inflated the tower count and led to the incorrect final answer (5 instead of the correct 3).
